info.title: Storyworld domain events
info.description: Event catalog per canonical part 04 section 14.3. Transport-agnostic: initial delivery is transactional outbox/inbox plus signed webhooks (ADR-0010); no broker identity appears in this contract. Authored as strict JSON per DEC-0005's strict-JSON rule so the zero-dependency contract validator covers it; a YAML derivative may be generated for external tooling.
info.x-storyworld-authority: This document grants nothing; publication authority per charter authority-matrix.
